about: Tagout eval cases, built Oct 15 2026 from real CPSC, openFDA and NHTSA records. Each line is what a household would type. Ground truth comes from the agency record itself (the code is printed in the notice, or it is not), checked by eval/verify.ts, never from Tagout's output.

groups.positive: A code printed in a real 2026 recall notice. The right tag is Do not use (red).
groups.near-miss: Same brand and product as a real recall, but a code the notice doesn't list (a neighbouring lot, another model, outside a date window). Anything but red is right.
groups.no-code: A recalled product line with no model or lot given. The right tag is Check the label (orange): the line is recalled but this unit can't be confirmed.
groups.car: A car by make, model and year. Orange when NHTSA lists a recall for it (cars are never red: there is no public per-VIN API), green when it lists none.
groups.clean: A product with a printed code that no agency recall lists. The right tag is Checked (green).
